---
title: "Internals"
---

The three pages that follow document the machinery behind the user-facing calls, the five
steps `run_scenarios` performs in order, the six objects that make up an estiMINT model
bundle, and the network stateMINT pushes its covariates through. None of it is needed to run
a scenario. All of it is needed to extend the stack or to read its source, and the same detail
accounts for behaviour the packages never announce, such as an input clamped to the edge of
its domain.

::: {.chapter-outline}
- [Pipeline architecture](architecture.qmd) — The five steps of `run_scenarios`, the three EIR paths, and the one batched call.
- [estiMINT internals](estimint-internals.qmd) — The model bundle, the monotone sweep over a boosted tree, and the clamped input domains.
- [stateMINT internals](statemint-internals.qmd) — The Mamba2 backbone, the sixteen-column input tensor, and the target transforms.
:::

The pages are independent and can be read in any order, though each assumes the user-facing
chapter for the package it describes. Covariates, `dn0`, EIR and the 157-window grid are
taken as given. Please see [Core Concepts](../03-concepts/index.qmd) for all four.
